walk.zh: 裙摆一样的身体，滑过草地。
walk.en: My gown-like body glides over the meadow.

walk.zh: 我走得很慢，像在数星星。
walk.en: I walk slowly, as if counting the stars.

walk.zh: 每一步都对应一颗星的移动。
walk.en: Each step matches the shift of one star.

walk.zh: 别看我脚，我的重心在别处。
walk.en: Don't watch my feet; my balance lies elsewhere.
I drift along and the grass only bends slightly.
Level forty-two footsteps are quite steady.
The future will remember the road I take.
I walk with my head up; the stars are above.

walk.zh: 草地上的影子比我先到。
walk.en: My shadow reaches the grass before I do.

walk.zh: 我不急，时间对我没意义。
walk.en: I am in no hurry; time means little to me.
The wind lifts my hem; I pay it no mind.
The night road is bright; the stars light it for me.

idle.en: The stars are moving, and I am calculating.

idle.zh: 今晚的星象，有一处不安。
idle.en: Tonight's sky holds one uneasy sign.

idle.zh: 我不说话，是不想说出结局。
idle.en: I stay silent because I don't want to name the ending.
I have looked at your future three times.

idle.zh: 云散了，我重新开始推算。
idle.en: The clouds part, so I begin my reading again.

idle.zh: 站在这儿，我能听见星的声音。
idle.en: Standing here, I can hear the stars speak.

idle.zh: 天体在转，我的头也在转。
idle.en: The heavens turn, and my head turns with them.
Some answers are better left unknown.
A star chart is embroidered on my gown.

idle.zh: 别问我看多久，看的是很远。
idle.en: Don't ask how long I look; I look very far.

idle.zh: 我算到了春天的一场雨。
idle.en: I have foreseen a rain that comes in spring.

idle.zh: 我的身体轻得像一段光。
idle.en: My body is as light as a length of light.
The wind's direction is on the chart as well.

look_player.zh: 我看见你的未来了，模糊的。
look_player.en: I see your future, though it is blurred.
You have a long road left; don't rush.

look_player.zh: 你的影子里，有星的碎片。
look_player.en: There are fragments of stars in your shadow.
I stare at you, but not with ill intent.

look_player.zh: 你左手会抖，自己知道吗？
look_player.en: Your left hand trembles—did you know that?

look_player.zh: 别问我活多久，我不会答。
look_player.en: Don't ask how long I live; I won't answer.
When you smile, you resemble a certain star.
I see old wounds on you.

look_player.zh: 你的名字，我念不出来，可我记得。
look_player.en: I cannot pronounce your name, but I remember it.
You are standing exactly where the starlight falls.

look_player.zh: 我看了你很久，你才刚到。
look_player.en: I have watched you long, though you just arrived.

look_player.zh: 你身后有两条路，还没选。
look_player.en: Two roads lie behind you, still unchosen.

look_player.zh: 你的鞋带松了，这我没算到。
look_player.en: Your shoelace is loose—that I did not foresee.

look_player.zh: 我不会告诉你，你哪一天走。
look_player.en: I will not tell you the day you leave.

tempted.zh: 那颗星更亮，我要靠近看。
tempted.en: That star is brighter; I must get closer.

tempted.zh: 给我一张星图，我就跟你走。
tempted.en: Give me a star chart and I'll go with you.
The darker it gets, the brighter my mind.
Don't raise a torch; it will hide the starlight.

tempted.zh: 那块高地，能看见整片天。
tempted.en: From that high ground you can see the whole sky.

tempted.zh: 有流星，我得记下它的路。
tempted.en: A meteor—I must record the path it takes.
Your crystal is reflecting the stars.

tempted.zh: 我喜欢安静的地方，带我去。
tempted.en: I like quiet places; take me to one.
When the moon rises, I will set out.

tempted.zh: 给我一点时间，等云过去。
tempted.en: Give me a moment, until the clouds pass.

collide.zh: 你穿过我的裙边，星图乱了。
collide.en: You passed through my hem and disturbed the chart.
Don't bump me; my prediction will skew.

collide.zh: 你的手碰到我的裙，很凉吧。
collide.en: Your hand brushed my gown—cold, isn't it?

collide.zh: 我退半步，星轨就变了一点。
collide.en: I step back half a pace and the star paths shift.

collide.zh: 撞散了我的光，得重新聚。
collide.en: You scattered my light; I must gather it again.
You are standing on my shadow.

collide.zh: 我没事，只是算错了一颗星。
collide.en: I'm fine; I merely misjudged one star.
I'm light; one touch spins me halfway around.

mate.zh: 你的星图，和我的能拼上。
mate.en: Your star chart fits together with mine.

mate.zh: 我们一起等那颗星落下。
mate.en: Let's wait together for that star to fall.
Two prophecies overlap into a single line.

mate.zh: 别怕我算到结局，先看今夜。
mate.en: Don't fear the ending; look at tonight first.

mate.zh: 你的手很暖，星光是冷的。
mate.en: Your hand is warm; starlight is cold.

mate.zh: 我把最亮的一颗，留给你。
mate.en: I save the brightest one for you.
Standing side by side, our star paths align.

mate.zh: 你也在数吗？数到第几颗了。
mate.en: Are you counting too? Which star have you reached?
Come closer slowly; don't disturb the sky.

mate.zh: 这一夜，我只算我们俩的星。
mate.en: Tonight I read only our two stars.

pickup.en: A meteor fragment, and it is still warm.

pickup.zh: 这片玻璃，映得像我裙上的星。
pickup.en: This glass reflects the stars on my gown.

pickup.zh: 我把它放在掌心，看它的光。
pickup.en: I set it in my palm and study its light.

pickup.zh: 谁掉了星形吊坠？我认得。
pickup.en: Who dropped this star-shaped pendant? I know it.

pickup.zh: 这枚石头，昨夜从天上来的。
pickup.en: This stone came down from the sky last night.

pickup.zh: 捡起来，它的轨迹就归我。
pickup.en: Once picked up, its path belongs to me.
Little thing, shining like a distant star.

pickup.zh: 我收好，将来会有人来取。
pickup.en: I'll keep it; someone will come for it later.
My fingers are cold, and the object colder.

pickup.zh: 别丢，星星掉下来不容易。
pickup.en: Don't drop it; falling stars are rare.

target_acquire.zh: 它的星象变暗了，就是它。
target_acquire.en: Its sign has dimmed—it is the one.
I have calculated that it strikes first.
That shadow was already here three days ago.

target_acquire.zh: 它踩碎了我的图，不能放过。
target_acquire.en: It crushed my chart; I cannot let that pass.
The target is set; the star paths point to it.

target_acquire.zh: 我看见它的结局，现在动手。
target_acquire.en: I have seen its ending; I act now.
A heavy dark aura hangs about it.
Lock onto it; let the chart not be wasted.

target_acquire.zh: 我数到那颗星熄灭为止。
target_acquire.en: I count until that star goes out.

target_acquire.zh: 它以为躲得好，星不会说谎。
target_acquire.en: It thinks it hides well; stars do not lie.

targeting.zh: 你往哪走，星都告诉我了。
targeting.en: The stars have told me where you'll go.

targeting.zh: 别躲了，你的路只到这里。
targeting.en: Stop hiding; your road ends here.

targeting.zh: 我抬手，光就落在你脚边。
targeting.en: I raise my hand and light falls at your feet.
One more step and the prophecy comes true.

targeting.zh: 我的眼睛不看现在，看结果。
targeting.en: My eyes don't see now; they see outcomes.
You are breathing hard; I can hear it.

targeting.zh: 裙上的星一颗颗亮起来。
targeting.en: The stars on my gown light one by one.
Don't look back; there is no road behind.
I have already watched this fight once.
Don't make me speak your ending aloud.

melee_attack.en: A shaft of starlight strikes your shoulder.

melee_attack.zh: 念头压下去，你脚下裂开。
melee_attack.en: My thought descends and the ground cracks beneath you.
The chart opens, and the impact arrives.
I practiced this blow for a long time.

melee_attack.zh: 空气一紧，你的呼吸就乱。
melee_attack.en: The air tightens and your breathing falters.
Light spills from my hem, and it's hot.

melee_attack.zh: 你看不见它，可它已经打中。
melee_attack.en: You cannot see it, yet it has struck.

melee_attack.zh: 我不喜欢动手，但星说了。
melee_attack.en: I dislike striking, but the stars said so.

spawn.zh: 我从草浪里升起，带着星光。
spawn.en: I rise from the grass waves carrying starlight.

spawn.zh: 四十二级，我算得比以前远。
spawn.en: At level forty-two I see farther than before.

spawn.zh: 我落在这里，像一颗迟到的星。
spawn.en: I land here like a star arriving late.
Look up; all of tonight's stars are here.
Someone is coming, and I wait.

spawn.zh: 我睁开眼，先看天，再看地。
spawn.en: I open my eyes and look first to sky, then ground.
My gown spreads out and the grass falls still.
Don't fear; I am only passing through.
The wind is light—good for calculation.

spawn.zh: 我在这里站一会儿，等云散。
spawn.en: I'll stand here a while until the clouds clear.
Starlight settles on my shoulders, and it's heavy.

generic.zh: 疼，但结局不会因此改变。
generic.en: It hurts, but the outcome will not change.
A corner of my gown has torn.
Not much blood; my star has not gone out.
That blow—I foresaw it long ago.
My light has scattered; I must gather it.

generic.zh: 别打我的头，星图在那儿。
generic.en: Not my head—the star chart is in there.

generic.zh: 我跪了一下，很快会站起。
generic.en: I dropped to one knee, but I'll rise soon.
The pain is real, and so is the future.
You hit hard, and I have noted it.

fire.zh: 火会烧掉星图，也会烧掉我。
fire.en: Fire burns star charts, and it burns me too.

fall.zh: 坠下去时，我看见了落点。
fall.en: As I fell, I saw exactly where I'd land.

drown.zh: 水面上没有星，我找不到方向。
drown.en: No stars on the water, so I've lost my bearings.

explosion.zh: 光比星还亮，晃得我算错了。
explosion.en: Light brighter than stars made me miscalculate.

projectile.zh: 它飞来的路线，我漏算了。
projectile.en: I failed to predict the path it would fly.

magic.zh: 别的力量在改我的星图。
magic.en: Another power is rewriting my star chart.

starvation.en: I'm so hungry the stars are turning white.

lightning.en: The thunder shattered a whole line of stars.

void.zh: 脚下没有星，也没有地面。
void.en: No stars below me, and no ground either.
